sources.title: AI superintelligence: Richard Branson, Prince Harry call for pause
sources.quote_checked: 95% of Americans don't want a race to superintelligence, and experts want to ban it.

sources.title: 'Team Human' vs. AI: MIT expert issues warning on artificial general intelligence risks
sources.quote_checked: we can create an amazingly inspiring future with tool AI as long as we don't build AGI | Once these artificial intelligences get smarter than we are, they will take control, they'll make us irrelevant, | This AGI race isn't an arms race; it's a suicide race, | The only winning move is not to play.

sources.title: MIT professor behind famous 'AI pause letter' still thinks a pause is needed
sources.quote_checked: Making models more powerful than what we have now, that has to be put on pause | Agreeing on what the safety standards are will naturally cause the pause, | a race to the bottom

sources.title: Pause Giant AI Experiments: An Open Letter
sources.quote_checked: We call on all AI labs to immediately pause for at least 6 months the training of AI systems more powerful than GPT-4.

sources.title: Life 3.0: Being Human in the Age of Artificial Intelligence (excerpt)
